title: lathyrus japonicus f. albescens
intro: Lathyrus japonicus f. albescens, commonly known as White Japanese Pea, is a flowering plant that belongs to the legume family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of White Japanese Pea include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and act as an antioxidant. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
